content.short: Particle Network provides Web3 development services, including secure authentication and NFT solutions.
content.description: Particle Network provides seamless onboarding, wallet integration, and NFT marketplace capabilities for developers and users in the blockchain space. It delivers social-authentication powered by MPC-TSS, white-label wallets compatible with Account Abstraction (ERC-4337), and end-to-end NFT solutions for easy marketplace creation and management. With Particle Network's middleware, developers access a cohesive toolset to streamline workflows and build more user-friendly blockchain applications across Web, iOS, Android, Unity, Unreal Engine, Flutter, React Native, and Cocos Creator.

resources.title: UniversalX Case Study: Lessons From Building a Chain-Agnostic App
resources.tldr: Promising one account and one balance across every chain turns out to be mostly an accounting problem. An honest retrospective on what that cost to build.

resources.title: Accepting Stablecoins From Any Chain in Your dApp
resources.tldr: Follows a developer workshop rather than a launch post, so it stays concrete about what a user actually experiences when their funds are on the wrong chain.

resources.title: The Universal SDK: Building Chain-Agnostic Apps
resources.tldr: Opens on the real problem: chains, bridges and fragmented capital all multiplying faster than any team can integrate them. Then covers what abstracting that away requires.
